changelog:
• Cross-Platform Release: Catchify is now available for both Android (APK) and iOS (IPA)
• Synced Live Lyrics: Real-time streaming synchronized lyrics alongside playback
• Spotify Playlist Import: Import any public Spotify playlist directly via share link
• Offline Audio: High-quality offline song and playlist downloads with zero ads
• Equalizer & Audio FX: Customizable equalizer with bass boost presets
• 21+ Languages: Localized interface and curated music in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, and more
